## Summary

On 18 September 2026, Sara Zago gave the talk *Aperiodic EEG Across Aging and Neurological Disorders: A Clinical Perspective* at the congress of the SIPF (Società Italiana di Psicofisiologia e Neuroscienze) in Noto, dedicated to the aging brain.

The talk was part of the symposium *The Aperiodic Component of EEG: Promise, Pitfalls, and Perspectives in Aging and Neuropathology*.
